svg.title: Super Rare hunts
svg.desc: Super Rare hunts. Each target sits on a random map of its territory, a sector of one server. The compass reads COLD four or more maps away, COOL at two or three, WARM on the next map, HOT on its map and BURNING close to its point; stepping on the point starts the battle. Once it loses 25% of its bar in one fight it flees to another map of the territory, keeping the damage, and each new meeting gives it 20% more stats, stacking; it takes half damage. 13 hunts unlock in order: the Ogremon tutorial, then 12 Super Rares from level 29 to 61. Each win gives its crystal (two with the Hunter's Mark) and a new hero skin.
svg.text: The Sepikmon in the Velvet Room gives the hunts. A temperature compass leads you to the target.
